caption: The drawing is in grayscale and features two main elements: a detailed rendering of an ornate pitcher and a technical overhead sketch of the same object. The larger, more detailed drawing, positioned on the right, shows a side view of a polished, reflective pitcher with a rounded body and a hinged lid. The lid has a small ornamental finial on top, and the handle is elaborately decorated with scroll motifs. The spout is also decorated with similar ornate patterns. To the upper left of the drawing, in a separate outlined box, there is a simple line drawing showing a top-down view of the pitcher, highlighting its circular shape and the position of the handle and spout. The paper itself is off-white or light beige, and the drawing is executed entirely in pencil, using a combination of fine lines and shaded areas to create volume and highlight the reflective surfaces of the object. There are annotations for scale and a name, "Gabriel Wilson," written at the bottom left corner.
title: Silver Teapot
